title: FLA import: text-field and bitmap-item filters silently dropped
description: In flash8-binary.ts lines 1656 and 1514, filters on CPicText and CPicBitmap objects are skipped with a warnOnce call. Implement parsing and import of these filter arrays so they populate the model's filters field, enabling round-trip fidelity for Flash 8 FLA files with filtered text/bitmap objects.
